paper_title: EvoAgentX: An Automated Framework for Evolving Agentic Workflows

evidence.primary: The poster contains dense bullet points with small font sizes across all sections, creating a high text density that overwhelms the reader and increases cognitive load.

secondary_issues.visual_hierarchy_weak: The main contribution and key results are not visually emphasized; the large title and bottom banner are the only prominent elements, but they do not guide the reader to the core method or findings.
secondary_issues.space_imbalance: The left column (Motivation, Problem) is densely packed with text, while the right column (Conclusion, Key Findings) has large empty spaces, creating an uneven visual weight.
